notes: Read the source file line by line before editing. The default-exported LocationsPage, the isUnnamedLocation helper, the VisitedLocation type, every state name (vehicleId/vehicles/setVehicleId/page/pageSize/search/appliedName/start/end/setRange/rawLocations/isLoading/error/locations/filteredLocations/totalVisits/totalTime/uniquePlaces/topLocation/avgDurationS/uniqueCities/visitsChartData/timeChartData), the API path (GET /locations?vehicle_id=&limit=&offset= via useQuery + request), the query key ['visited-locations', vehicleId, page, pageSize], the SI unit handling (total_duration_s seconds -> hours via formatDuration), and all i18n keys are preserved verbatim.
L1-5 file header/docblock -> condensed into the native port header comment.
L7 import {useMemo, useState} -> useMemo/useState preserved; useCallback/useEffect/useRef added for the inlined hooks + freshness tick.
L8 @tanstack/react-query useQuery -> imported from @tanstack/react-query (kept); UseQueryResult added for the DataFreshnessAuto query type.

L9 react-i18next useTranslation -> inlined native useTranslation(): t(key, fallback?, params?) returns the English fallback (or key) with {{name}} interpolation; no i18n runtime in the parity bundle, every key preserved at the call site.

L10 lucide-react {MapPin, Clock, Hash, Trophy, Navigation, Building2} -> native glyphs: MapPin -> <SemanticIcon name="mapPinned"> (EmptyState icon) and the per-row count uses a '#' AppText; Clock/Trophy/Navigation/Building2/Hash collapse onto recoloured 2-char glyph tiles in MetricCard ('CK'/'TY'/'NV'/'CT'/'#'). No SVG/DOM icon library is imported.

L12 PageContainer from @/components/layout -> inlined native PageContainer (header title/subtitle/actions + ScrollView; loading -> ActivityIndicator, error -> error box, else children), preserving the title/subtitle/loading={isLoading}/error props passed at L152-156.

L13 {GlassPanel, Select, Pagination} from @/components/ui -> GlassPanel is the ported native ../../../../components/ui/GlassPanel; Select is an inlined option-chip row (onChange receives the value, mirroring e.target.value); Pagination is inlined (showing X–Y of Z + first/prev/page/next/last pager buttons) preserving the page/pageSize/total/onPageChange contract.

L14 {MetricCard, DataFreshnessAuto} from @/components/data-display -> MetricCard is inlined (colour-tinted glyph tile + label + value; the web neon green/blue/cyan/purple/amber map to native theme-token tints); DataFreshnessAuto is inlined (status dot + relative-time chip + refetch-on-press, 30s tick cleaned up on unmount).

L15 {Skeleton, EmptyState} from @/components/feedback -> the already-ported native Skeleton (height=300/280 charts, height=64 rounded list rows) and EmptyState (icon/title/message + actionTo for the 'View drives' deep-link and action for 'Clear search').

L16 FadeIn from @/components/motion -> the ported native ../../../components/motion/FadeIn wrapping the summary grid, both chart panels, and the All-Locations panel (same four sections as the source).

L17 {SearchInput, FilterBar, ActiveFilterChips, RangePicker, type FilterChipDescriptor} from @/components/forms -> RangePicker is the ported native ../../../components/forms/RangePicker (value {start,end}, onChange, align 'end', triggerTestId 'locations-range' preserved); SearchInput is an inlined debounced (250ms) TextInput + clear button (historyScope accepted but the localStorage history dropdown is dropped); FilterBar is an inlined wrapping row; ActiveFilterChips is inlined (removable chip + Clear all; the overflow '+N more' popover is dropped — this page never exceeds one chip); FilterChipDescriptor is re-exported from this module.
L18 useFilteredList from @/hooks/useFilteredList -> ported verbatim (substring match across fields, returns the list unchanged for empty query).

L19 useRangeState from @/hooks/useRangeState -> inlined: defaultPresetId 'all' resolves to [2015-01-01, today]; RN has no URL/localStorage so the range lives in useState and persistKey 'locations.range' is accepted but unused; setRange + the L168-171 setPage(1) batching preserved.

L20 {useUrlNumber, useUrlString} from @/hooks/useUrlState -> inlined useState stand-ins (RN has no browser URL/search params); [, setUrlVehicleId]=useUrlNumber('vehicle_id',0), [page,setPage]=useUrlNumber('page',1), [search,setSearch]=useUrlString('q','') all preserved including the onPickVehicle setVehicleId+setUrlVehicleId pair (L72-75).

L21 useSelectedVehicle from @/hooks/useSelectedVehicle -> inlined native useSelectedVehicle over the ported useVehicles(): keeps the web hook's final 'first vehicle is the default' precedence in local state; returns vehicleId/vehicles/setVehicleId.

L22-25 {ChartTooltip, BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer} from @/components/charts -> the vertical-layout Recharts BarChart collapses onto an inlined native HorizontalBarChart (per-row label + value/max track fill + formatted value) with the identical #10b981 (visits) and #a855f7 (hours) fills. No Recharts/ResponsiveContainer/Tooltip/ChartTooltip primitives are imported.
L27 usePageTitle from @/hooks/usePageTitle -> inlined native no-op (RN has no document.title); the call site + translated 'Locations' key preserved (L67).

L28 useUnits from @/hooks/useUnits -> inlined native useUnits() exposing formatDuration only (the page's sole unit need); derives locale + precision from the ported useSettings() and converts SI seconds to hours with the 'h' suffix exactly like the web lib formatDuration (DEFAULT duration precision 0, settings.decimal_precision override). The formatDuration call sites (L185/L187/L291) are preserved verbatim.
L29 formatDate from @/lib/dateFormat -> inlined faithfully ('MMM D, YYYY' via toLocaleDateString, '—' for nullish/unparseable). RN uses the device locale (the web's browser-locale analog).
